opportunities.name: Track Megabus by service number
opportunities.description: Open Megabus Check my bus > Track my bus, choose Service Number tab, enter a service number (and select origin city) and find the bus.
steps: Type the service number into the search combobox

opportunities.name: Browse NPS parks by state
opportunities.description: Use Find a Park by State menu to open a given state's parks and then view a section (e.g., Current Conditions, Basic Information) for a park.
steps: Click Find a Park by State
Open the park's desired info section (Current Conditions, Basic Information, etc.)

opportunities.name: Resy book event tickets
opportunities.description: Open a Resy special event listing, set number of tickets, and reserve/select a time slot.
steps: Click the event link in Special Events & Experiences
Select the ticket count in the combobox
Choose a time slot or click Book Now/Reserve Now
